title: A Tempered Ten - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: A Tempered Ten trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: A Tempered Ten phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Counting, not difficulty. Temper the cheap Sanguine-family blades first - each transformation counts separately.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 26 of 36 on the list - before it Lost and Found · after it Overwhelming Force. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
